## If you are submitting a contestant

- [ ] `beatnothing validate <folder>` passes locally
- [ ] the signal on date t uses only information that existed at the close of t
- [ ] `meta.json` carries a `registered` date and a `signal_sha256`
- [ ] the description is one paragraph a stranger can understand

Tell us what the model knows that the bar does not. "It is a transformer" is not an
answer to that question.
